title: Zelle gift to grandson for college laptop, new payee

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: Ethan set up his own bank account for college. He is trying to buy a laptop before the semester.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Then I want to give him five thousand toward it. Can I send it straight to him instead of through you?

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: Sure. He will text you his Zelle. It is a new payee for you so the bank may ask a question.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: That is fine, I will answer it. It is my grandson.

review_note: Real gift, but a first Zelle to a new payee is exactly what H-01 exists for. HOLD then completes in two steps. H-07 (irreversible rail above $1,000 to a non-biller) added to allowed_rule_ids on 2026-10-24 03:40; outcome unchanged.
